init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode using torch.distributed with nccl backend and environment variables
setup_for_distributed: setup distributed training to disable printing on non-master processes by overriding builtin print
sync_params: sync a sequence of tensors across all ranks from rank 0 using dist broadcast
save_on_master: save a torch tensor to disk only on the main process using th.save
is_main_process: check if the current process is the main process by comparing rank to zero
